exact_statement: For every even k>=2 set delta=2^(-k), e=2^(-k/2), r=2k, p=2^(-r), and let F be the point-control activation of the actual physical selector between the quadratic bent sign b on k data bits and b-2*1_zero. On the control-first stopping tree ending at the bent/point-flipped seeds, equip constant leaves with delta_empty and seed leaves either with their exact Fourier laws or both with the uniform data-subset reference. The A097 compatible lift has I_removed=p(2k c+delta), I_terminal=p(k/2+k delta), c=1-e+delta; exact B_tree and K_tree are the rational-logarithmic node expressions in DERIVATION.md. B_tree<=3 I_removed for every even k>=2, and complete root CE<=(3+2/ln2)I_removed+2I_terminal. Exact leaf laws give K_tree=0; uniform leaf laws give 0<=K_tree/I_removed<=8delta(1-delta)/[(2k c+delta)ln2], so the credit is O(2^(-k)/k), and both corrected and uncorrected erasure rates tend to 2. At k=2,4,6,8 the uniform-reference residual rates have certified rational intervals around 2.352431205059,2.320544689093,2.217959018446,2.159650515335. This is a scoped application on a known FEI family; no universal arbitrary-seed/overlapping-control payment is claimed.
